title: Winch
description: To smash items without losing anvil durability, place a winch with a crank on its side. Put some rope in it. Then, right clicking the crank will pull the rope closer to the winch, and crouch + right click will let the anvil drop.
The winch has to be at least four blocks above the ground, otherwise it wouldn't be able to lift the anvil.
You need an <keyword>undamaged anvil</keyword> to use this block.
Also, make sure there are no items in the offhand while the winch is in operation!
Вам необходима <keyword>целая наковальня</keyword>, чтобы воспользоваться этим блоком.
Так же для работы лебедки во второй руке не должно быть предметов!
